title: ReviewSyncEvent
description: One idempotent workflow event. Re-applying the same event_id is a no-op. script_created cannot approve. script_approved does not authorize a cut or publication. QC_completed never sets publish_approved. publication_verified changes only the named platform. Optional note is card text, not a platform. Optional same_clip_ids move those review cards to 已發佈 only after a platform is published, without changing their platform flags or approval flags. email_parsed kind=publish sets publish_approved only when artifact_id matches and both QC checks pass. artifact_archived records a superseded or taken-down file: publish_approved stays false and current platform flags are not left published. hold_not_publishable keeps qc.ready and publish_approved false for that artifact only.
